name: markov_model
description: A state-transition (Markov) diagram: 2–6 health/process states as circles, transition arrows between them (with a probability/rate label), and self-loops for states that also "stay". Choose this for ANY request about a Markov model, a health-state transition diagram, or a cycle of states with probabilities of moving between them. All node placement is computed for you (a ring for 3+ states, a horizontal pair for 2); a state that no transition ever leaves renders as absorbing (plain ink, no color) automatically.

states.description: 2–6 state names, in the order they should be laid out.

transitions.description: Directed transitions between states named in `states`.

self_loops.description: State names that also have a "stay" probability — drawn with a small loop above the state.

layout.description: Node arrangement. Default: circle for 3+ states, chain for exactly 2.

highlight_state.description: One state name (must be in `states`) to highlight with a tinted halo behind it.

element_ids.state_<slug>: the ellipse for one state (slug: the state name, lowercased, non-alphanumeric characters replaced with _)
element_ids.state_label_<slug>: the state's name, centered inside its ellipse
element_ids.t_<i>: transition arrow i (0-indexed, in `transitions` order) — bowed automatically when the reverse transition also exists
element_ids.t_label_<i>: transition i's probability/rate label, when set
element_ids.loop_<slug>: the self-loop arc for a state named in `self_loops`
element_ids.hl_<slug>: tinted halo behind the state named by `highlight_state` — present only when set
element_ids.title: figure title, when set

examples.request: Draw a three-state Markov model: Well, Sick, Dead, with Well and Sick able to stay or transition, and Dead absorbing.
Draw a two-state Markov chain for a machine that's either working or broken, with a repair rate and a breakdown rate.
